description: Source code for a data model management module, including functions for browsing, retrieving, setting, and managing data model objects, leaves, and instances, with support for wildcards, dependencies, and various data types.

methods.name: dm_browse
methods.description: Recursively traverses data model objects and leaves, applying specified callback methods, with support for wildcards and dependency checks.

methods.name: dm_link_inst_obj
methods.description: Links an instance object within the data model, updating max instance count and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: dm_entry_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value(s) of a data model object or leaf based on input parameters, supporting wildcards and schema retrieval.

methods.name: dm_entry_get_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name or path of a data model object or leaf, with support for wildcards and hierarchical navigation.

methods.name: dm_entry_get_supported_dm
methods.description: Retrieves supported data models for a given object or leaf.

methods.name: dm_entry_get_instances
methods.description: Retrieves instances of a data model object, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: dm_entry_add_object
methods.description: Adds a new object instance in the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: dm_entry_delete_object
methods.description: Deletes an object instance from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: dm_entry_set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of a data model leaf, with type validation and change detection.

methods.name: dm_entry_get_reference_value
methods.description: Retrieves the reference value (linker) of a data model object or leaf.

methods.name: dm_entry_object_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific object exists in the data model.

methods.name: dm_entry_operate
methods.description: Performs an operation (e.g., command) on a data model object or leaf.

methods.name: dm_entry_event
methods.description: Triggers an event on a data model object or leaf.

methods.name: get_number_of_entries
methods.description: Counts the number of entries (instances) of a data model object.

methods.name: handle_instance
methods.description: Handles instance number assignment and updates for a section.

methods.name: handle_instance_without_section
methods.description: Creates an instance string without section context.

methods.name: get_empty
methods.description: Provides an empty string value for a parameter.
